proposed_public_sentence: Z-Sanctuary is a governed multi-project AI development ecosystem with implemented and verified components, while many broader capabilities remain under controlled development.

claims.claim: Z-Sanctuary Universe is the named hub organism; Z-Sanctuary Core is the named core-engine role for governance and verification coordination.

evidence_refs.label: Core engine roster
evidence_refs.title: Z-Sanctuary Core named among hub core engines

proves: Stable public umbrella and core-engine identity exist in sanctuary records

claims.claim: The hub contains implemented software slices with automated tests that passed on 2026-08-27.

evidence_refs.label: z-sanctuary-core smoke test
evidence_refs.result: 1 passed (thin: may pass if registry load fails)

claims.claim: Development is documented as human-gated and evidence-first: observe then verify then suggest then human decides; readiness is not deploy.

evidence_refs.label: Z-Sanctuary Universe Constitution
evidence_refs.note: Frozen architecture; explicitly not a deploy grant

evidence_refs.label: Turtle Mode
evidence_refs.note: Guarded worker, not autopilot; no auto-merge

evidence_refs.label: GW-2 Steward split
evidence_refs.note: Navigator approved; Core held for evidence — law applied

proves: Human-gated laws exist in hub doctrine and were applied in GW-2

claims.claim: Named hub verification checks recently reported green for dashboard registry, alias integrity, data-leak audit, and API-spine registry signal.
proves: Those specific checkers reported healthy on the GW-2 / GW-2A window

limitations: Many capabilities remain under controlled development
